summary: OpenAI introduced two new transcription models in its API, GPT-Live-Transcribe for low-latency live audio and GPT-Transcribe for asynchronous batch transcription, reporting accuracy improvements over the prior GPT-Realtime-Whisper-1 model.

practices.reason: Two new transcription models are released with stated latency-optimized and accuracy-optimized variants, backed by concrete error-rate figures against the prior model.
practices.quote: GPT-Live-Transcribe’s semantic accuracy increased from 38.5% without free-form context to 44.6% with it. Across 22 languages on Common Voice, GPT-Live-Transcribe achieved a 19.70% transcription error rate, compared with 20.33% for GPT-Realtime-Whisper-1.

practices.reason: The post describes a concrete context-injection technique (free-form context, keywords, expected languages, prior turns) with a stated accuracy gain, implementable by any team building a transcription pipeline.
practices.quote: Builders can improve live audio transcription by providing: • Free-form context about the recording • Keywords for names and domain-specific terms • Expected input languages • Earlier transcribed turns as context

practices.reason: A new Context Aware ASR benchmark and comparisons on Common Voice and Real-World Audio Recording are named, giving a measurement approach a team could adopt to compare transcription models, though the benchmark itself is the lab's own.
practices.quote: On our new Context Aware Automatic Speech Recognition benchmark, GPT-Live-Transcribe’s semantic accuracy increased from 38.5% without free-form context to 44.6% with it.
